messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick post-all-hands thread: we're running two Q3 pilotsmanager hiring credits and an infra rotation fellows program. Capturing Qs and the simple how-to so managers can act.

Jonas (CTO): Short context: credits speed up scheduling/placement for priority roles; rotation fellows are 6-week cross-team assignments to unblock migrations without permanent headcount moves. Both are tactical to raise capacity quickly.

Amina (ENG Manager - Runtime): If I redeem a hiring credit, does it create a permanent slot?

Maya (People Ops): No  credits don't create headcount. They buy priority for scheduling, interview lanes, or a temporary fellow placement. Converting a fellow into a permanent hire follows the normal req + approval flow.

Sahil (VP Eng): Also: credits are limited. Use them for roles where fast onboarding materially affects product milestones. We expect managers to justify credit use in 1 line when redeeming.

Noah (Head of Recruiting): Ops note: scheduling SLA when a credit is used = 5 business days to full interview loop availability. Standard (no credit) = up to 15 business days depending on calendars. We'll mark GH reqs with `credit:yes` if redeemed.

Amina (ENG Manager - Runtime): Good. What's the time-to-offer goal for fellows -> perm conversion?

Priya (Finance): If a fellow is converted to perm and comp goes up >12% vs original band, Finance needs a short ROI blurb. We can usually approve within 3 business days for critical cases.

Maya (People Ops): Quick redemption steps (copy/paste into GH notes):
```
1) Add tag: credit:yes to the GH req
2) Post a 1-line justification in comments (impact + timeline)
3) @Noah schedules accelerated loop (5 business days target)
4) If converting fellow -> perm, open new req and tag @Priya + @Maya for fast review
```

Sahil (VP Eng): Interview guidance for fellows: include a 30-min systems walkthrough to ensure placement fits skill gaps. Panels should include at least one cross-team engineer. Scorecards have a new line: "fast onboarding potential."

Noah (Head of Recruiting): For the rotation fellows program: recruiters will present a short roster of screened candidates for 6-week placements. Teams can request up to 2 fellows from the roster; placements are temporary and centrally tracked. We'll share the roster link by Mon.

Amina (ENG Manager - Runtime): If a fellow already on my team is a clear long-term fit, do we need to repost?

Maya (People Ops): Yes  conversion requires a normal req. But we'll fast-track reviews for folks who came in via the fellows roster (use tag `fellow-convert`). Aim to submit the req within the 6-week window to preserve momentum.

Priya (Finance): Budget reminder: fellows are centrally funded for the 6-week pilot. Permanent hires consume team budget when converted. Exceptions for sign-on or relocation still need Finance sign-off.

Maya (People Ops): I'll put a 1-pager in the handbook with: credit rules, GH tags, fellow roster link, and conversion flow. Will post and ping this thread when live.

hr-bot: New doc posted -> https://handbook.redwood.ai/hiring/credits-fellows-pilot (doc id: 1560)

Amina (ENG Manager - Runtime): This is helpful  thanks, Maya. Will queue two fellows and hold one credit for a risky slot.

Noah (Head of Recruiting): Will send the roster & calendar lanes tomorrow.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone  reach out if you want help drafting the 1-line justification.
